name: Physical Security Perimeter
description: Ensure physical security perimeters are defined and used to protect areas containing sensitive information and systems.

compliant_if.detail: Asset inventory is present, confirming physical locations and perimeters are tracked.

partial_if.detail: Assets are inventoried but location data is incomplete for perimeter verification.

missing_if.detail: No asset inventory uploaded to verify physical security perimeters.

remediation: Define physical security perimeters for all areas containing sensitive information and critical systems.

name: Physical Entry Controls
description: Ensure physical entry points are protected by appropriate access controls to prevent unauthorized access.

compliant_if.detail: Asset and employee records confirm physical access controls and personnel tracking are in place.

partial_if.detail: Asset inventory exists but employee access records are not available for verification.

missing_if.detail: No asset inventory uploaded to verify physical entry controls.

remediation: Implement physical entry controls including badge access, visitor logs, and secure area restrictions.

name: Securing Offices, Rooms and Facilities
description: Ensure offices, rooms, and facilities are secured to prevent unauthorized access, damage, or interference with information and systems.

compliant_if.detail: Asset inventory confirms facility locations and security measures are tracked.

partial_if.detail: Assets are inventoried but ownership or facility responsibility is not assigned.

missing_if.detail: No asset records uploaded to verify facility security measures.

remediation: Secure all offices and facilities containing information assets. Document access restrictions per area.

name: Physical Security Monitoring
description: Ensure physical areas are monitored to detect and deter unauthorized access or security incidents.

compliant_if.detail: Asset inventory and governance records confirm physical monitoring (CCTV, alarms) is in place.

partial_if.detail: Assets are tracked but governance records do not confirm active physical monitoring.

missing_if.detail: No asset or governance records to verify physical security monitoring.

remediation: Implement physical security monitoring including CCTV, intrusion detection, and access logging.

name: Protecting Against Physical and Environmental Threats
description: Ensure measures are implemented to protect against physical and environmental threats.

compliant_if.detail: Asset records indicate environmental protections are documented for critical equipment.

partial_if.detail: Assets exist but criticality classification is incomplete for environmental risk assessment.

missing_if.detail: No asset inventory uploaded to assess environmental threat protection.

remediation: Implement protections against fire, flood, power failure, and other environmental threats for critical assets.

name: Working in Secure Areas
description: Ensure procedures are in place for working in secure areas.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records confirm secure area working procedures are documented.

partial_if.detail: Employee records exist but secure area procedures are not formally documented.

missing_if.detail: No governance records to verify secure area procedures.

remediation: Document procedures for working in secure areas including access rules, supervision, and prohibited activities.

name: Clear Desk and Clear Screen
description: Ensure clear desk and clear screen policies are applied to reduce information exposure.

compliant_if.detail: Governance records confirm a clear desk and clear screen policy is documented.

partial_if.detail: Employee records exist but clear desk policy is not formally documented in governance.

missing_if.detail: No governance records to verify clear desk and clear screen policy.

remediation: Implement and communicate a clear desk and clear screen policy. Include in security awareness training.

name: Equipment Siting and Protection
description: Ensure equipment is sited and protected to reduce risks from environmental threats and unauthorized access.

compliant_if.detail: Asset inventory includes location data confirming equipment siting is tracked.

partial_if.detail: Assets are inventoried but location or siting information is incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No asset inventory uploaded to verify equipment siting and protection.

remediation: Document equipment locations and ensure protection against environmental and physical threats.

name: Security of Assets Off-Premises
description: Ensure security of assets when used outside organizational premises.

compliant_if.detail: Asset and governance records confirm off-premises security procedures are in place.

partial_if.detail: Assets are tracked but no formal off-premises security policy is documented.

missing_if.detail: No asset records uploaded to verify off-premises asset security.

remediation: Define security procedures for assets used off-premises including encryption and physical protection.

name: Storage Media
description: Ensure storage media is managed and protected throughout its lifecycle.

compliant_if.detail: Asset inventory and governance records confirm storage media lifecycle management exists.

partial_if.detail: Assets are tracked but storage media management procedures are not formally documented.

missing_if.detail: No asset inventory uploaded to verify storage media management.

remediation: Implement storage media lifecycle management including classification, handling, and secure disposal.

name: Supporting Utilities
description: Ensure availability and protection of supporting utilities such as power and telecommunications.

compliant_if.detail: Asset inventory confirms utility infrastructure is tracked and protected.

partial_if.detail: Assets are inventoried but criticality of utility infrastructure is not classified.

missing_if.detail: No asset records uploaded to verify utility protection measures.

remediation: Document and protect supporting utilities (power, HVAC, telecoms) with redundancy for critical systems.

name: Cabling Security
description: Ensure power and telecommunications cabling is protected from interception or damage.

compliant_if.detail: Asset and network records confirm cabling infrastructure is documented and secured.

partial_if.detail: Assets are tracked but network cabling security details are not documented.

missing_if.detail: No asset or network records to verify cabling security.

remediation: Protect power and data cabling from interception. Use conduits and separate power from data runs.

name: Equipment Maintenance
description: Ensure equipment is correctly maintained to ensure availability and integrity.

compliant_if.detail: Asset inventory confirms equipment maintenance is tracked.

partial_if.detail: Assets are inventoried but maintenance ownership is not assigned.

missing_if.detail: No asset records uploaded to verify equipment maintenance.

remediation: Establish equipment maintenance schedules. Document all maintenance activities and assign responsible owners.

name: Secure Disposal or Re-use of Equipment
description: Ensure equipment is securely disposed of or reused to prevent information leakage.

compliant_if.detail: Asset and governance records confirm secure disposal procedures are documented.

partial_if.detail: Assets are tracked but no formal disposal procedures are documented.

missing_if.detail: No asset records uploaded to verify disposal procedures.

remediation: Implement secure disposal procedures including data sanitization and certified destruction for all equipment.
